title: ZipZtoneMTK
description: Adds compressed cobblestone with incredible multipliers. Can you make it?
body:
# ZipZtoneMTK This is a simple mod that adds compressed cobblestone, but the difficulty is anything but simple.
You can create compressed cobblestone up to a staggering 11790184577738583171520872861412518665678211592275841109096961 times the original size.
Can you make this cobblestone?
日本語/Japanese 圧縮丸石を追加する簡単なMODですが、難易度は簡単ではありません。
なんと最大で11790184577738583171520872861412518665678211592275841109096961倍圧縮丸石まで作ることができます。
あなたはこの丸石をつくることができるかな？
